worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 0) 20,000.00 + military retirement pay (person 0) 40,000.00 + military retirement pay (person 1) 30,000.00 = 90,000.00. Federal taxable income = 90,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction = 58,500.00 (the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form 40 (filing status married filing jointly): line 7 federal AGI 90,000.00. Line 8 additions 0.00; line 9 = 90,000.00 + 0.00 = 90,000.00. Form 39R Part B line 7 Social Security and railroad benefits included in federal income = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 8 retirement benefits deduction: line 8a 72,324.00; line 8b railroad benefits received 0.00; line 8c Social Security received (gross, both spouses, Box 5) 0.00; line 8d = 72,324.00 - 0.00 - 0.00, not below zero, = 72,324.00; line 8e (person 0 age 64: 40,000.00 qualifies, age 62 or older; person 1 age 60: 30,000.00 does not qualify, under 62) = 40,000.00; line 8f smaller of 8d and 8e = 40,000.00. Line 18 health insurance premiums: none in the inputs, 0.00. Line 24 total subtractions = 0.00 + 40,000.00 = 40,000.00. Form 40 line 10 40,000.00; line 11 total adjusted income = 90,000.00 - 40,000.00 = 50,000.00. Line 12a boxes checked 0. Standard Deduction Worksheet: line 1 31,500.00; line 4 31,500.00; line 5 0 x 1,600.00 = 0.00; line 6 31,500.00. Line 15 0.00 (no Schedule A); line 16 31,500.00. Line 17 = 50,000.00 - 31,500.00 = 18,500.00. Line 18 federal Form 1040 lines 13a and 13b taken as 0.00; line 19 Idaho taxable income 18,500.00. Line 20 worksheet: line 1 18,500.00; line 2 9,622.00; line 3 = 8,878.00; line 4 at 5.3%; line 5 tax = 8,878.00 x 5.3% = 470.534, to the cent 470.53 (the return rounds to whole dollars, PDF p.8, and shows 471; expected keeps the formula). Lines 21-24 credits 0.00; line 25 0.00; line 26 470.53. Food Tax Credit Worksheet (Form 40 line 43): 2 x 155.00 = 310.00. State income tax = 470.53 - 310.00 = 160.53. Line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax 10.00 is on the return but the projection does not charge it (approximations). Each person's age counts: person 1 is under 62, not employed, and not classified as disabled, so that pension stays out of line 8e on the return too.
accepted_approximations: The Permanent Building Fund tax of 10 a return (Form 40 line 31) is not charged.
